description: The full delivery loop: Threshold, Threshold East, Castoff Walk, and out to the Marquee — in that order or not at all. 20₵.
name: The Loop

{who} pushes on through Threshold East, counting the stops left out loud.
{who} keeps jogging, sweat starting to show.
{who} weaves through Threshold East without breaking pace.
{who} cuts across Castoff Walk without breaking stride.
{who} barely slows down crossing Castoff Walk.
